summary: Iteration 2: Wedding totals, actual costs/profit, and negative-value validation. Backend: 45/45 pytest pass (the 27 regression tests, including the previously failing zero-cost costs_recorded test, plus 18 new tests in test_wedding_totals.py). UI tested end to end and all checks pass. With quantity 1, 1000 or 500 and Card 5000 / Printing 2000 / Discount 500 / Advance 3000, the form shows Total ₹6,500.00 and Balance ₹3,500.00, and the backend saves 6500/3500. Changing card cost recalculates live. Editing quantity to 1200 on the Job Details tab keeps the total at 6500. Cost Management with actual card 3000 and printing 1500 shows ₹4,500 / ₹2,000 / 30.77%, recalculates live, and the backend values match; selling prices stay 5000/2000. Negative card/printing/discount/advance/amount/actual-cost values show 'Value cannot be negative' and disable submit. Advance greater than total shows an error. The backend rejects negatives with 422 and advance > total with 400. The print sheet shows the selling fields and no actual costs, profit or margin. Other Printing: 1500/500 gives balance 1000, and production cost 900 gives profit 600 (40%). Work Management grid and search, delete to Recycle Bin, and Reports Daily all work. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Design items from iteration_1 still apply: native date inputs instead of the shadcn date picker, and toasts covering the header buttons.
